title: Keplerian Orbits
subtitle: Conic Section Gravitational Ephemerides
description: Multi-body planetary orbital mechanics following Kepler's laws with eccentric anomaly transcendental equation solvers.
mathNotation: r(\nu) = \frac{a(1 - e^2)}{1 + e \cos\nu}, \quad M = E - e \sin E, \quad T^2 = \frac{4\pi^2}{G(M_1 + M_2)} a^3
formulaCompact: E_{k+1} = E_k - (E_k - e*sin(E_k) - M) / (1 - e*cos(E_k)),  x = a*cos(E) - ae
